hero.lede: SpaceX IPO Exchange is the dedicated platform for accredited investors to acquire pre-IPO SpaceX shares, Tesla equity, vehicles and Starlink connectivity — all in one secure ecosystem.

s01.title: The most ambitious private company on Earth.
s01.lede: From reusable rockets to a 7,000+ satellite constellation, SpaceX is building the infrastructure of the next century. Early position before the public offering.

reusable.d: 300+ successful Falcon 9 landings have collapsed the cost of orbit by 10×.

starlink.d: A global broadband network with 5M+ active subscribers across 100+ countries.

starship.d: Fully-reusable super-heavy lift architecture targeting Mars and lunar logistics.

value.d: From $74B in 2021 to ~$420B in 2025 — among the fastest value creation in history.

defense.d: Long-tail government revenue from NASA, USSF and allied space agencies.

stack.d: From propulsion to silicon to ground stations — a fully owned aerospace platform.

s02.title: A $10,000 allocation in 2021 is worth ~$56,750 today.
s02.lede: Modeled on SpaceX's secondary-market price progression. Past performance is not a guarantee of future results, but the trajectory speaks for itself.

s04.title: Connect anywhere on Earth.

faq.q1: Who can invest in pre-IPO SpaceX shares?
faq.a1: Currently open to accredited investors globally; institutional structures available on request.
faq.a2: Through SPV structures held with qualified custodians; documentation is provided per allocation.
faq.a3: Bank transfers (USD, EUR, GBP) and supported cryptocurrencies including BTC, ETH and USDC.
faq.a4: The standard minimum is $10,000, with select rounds available from $5,000.
